description: Open/route/close smoke on Pharo 13. Kept beside the Pharo 14 profile because the 14 VM PharoLauncher fetches does not start on every machine: on arm64 macOS its bundled libgit2 fails to resolve git_libgit2_init at image startup, which is a VM packaging problem rather than a PLexus one. Use this one to exercise the suite while that is true.
